# Marketing Maturity Assessment

`marketing-maturity-assessment` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Strategy & Positioning
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/marketing-maturity-assessment/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which parts of our marketing system are the weak links to fix first for our stage?

**Inputs:** An answer from 0 (not yet) to 3 (fully) to each of 18 statements, three per dimension - positioning, audience and demand, website and conversion, sales and pipeline, retention and expansion, measurement and economics; optionally the company's stage, whether the evidence behind each dimension was checked, and the answers from a previous run

**Output:** A 0-100 score per dimension and overall with its band (Scattered, Emerging, Established, Compounding), the two or three weak links to fix first in order with the move and the skills to run, flags on any high self-score with no evidence, and the change per dimension since the previous run

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill marketing-maturity-assessment`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/marketing-maturity-assessment/resources/maturity-assessment.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/marketing-maturity-assessment/resources/maturity-assessment.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It is a self-assessment against AAJ's own bands, not a benchmark. Nothing in it says how you rank against other companies.
- Scores are only as honest as the answers. It flags high scores with no evidence marked, but cannot check the artefacts itself.
- Each dimension is an average of three answers, so a 'fully' and a 'not yet' can land as a middling score. The engine flags the split; read the answers, not only the score.
- The statements move over quarters, so monthly re-runs mostly show changes in how people answered, not in the function.

**Review before acting:** The founder or marketing lead checks the artefact behind every flagged high score (positioning statement, ICP, CAC by channel, NRR and GRR) and re-scores any that are missing before the weak links set the plan.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/marketing-maturity-assessment](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/marketing-maturity-assessment)
